name: 1563-nonstream-llama31-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, bf16 -- an ungated re-upload of the same weights, used because meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is gated.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 8B: 32 layers, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 128256; 16.1 GB of bf16 weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, bounded at 600 requests with a 900 s safety cap, no warmup.
workload: 600 ShareGPT conversations replayed as single-turn text completions -- prompt is the human turn, requested generation length is the length of the assistant turn that followed it (standard sampler filter: >=2 turns, first two only, drop prompt<4 or output<4 tokens, drop prompt>1024 or prompt+output>2048). Prompts mean 211 tokens (4-1021), requested generations mean 208 tokens (4-1547). The client does not stream: `stream: false`, one whole response per request.
purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant returning complete replies to 32 concurrent users, short prompts, one 8B-model GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented block is skipped by the reader, so a key written as a
# nested mapping is dropped and the server starts without it.

model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

tp-size: 1

max-running-requests: 10

mem-fraction-static: 0.85

random-seed: 42
